title: The Island Reality Show
teaser: On day twenty of filming, producer Yartsev was found dead in the editing tent on the beach. At that very minute all twelve cameras on the island froze, so a show that films every breath has not a single frame of the murder. Yartsev's monitor shows tomorrow's episode, titled "Exposed", but who it exposes we'll never know: the last forty minutes of footage were wiped. The boat from the mainland won't come until morning.

habits.label: Sand in the trainers
habits.habit: Beach sand always crunching in their trainers
clues: The editing tent floor was swept in the evening, yet now there's a little heap of fine white sand by Yartsev's chair, as if someone emptied out a shoe. The culprit has sand in their trainers.
Beach sand is scattered on the steps of the crew villa, which contestants aren't allowed into. The trail runs from the door to the stairs. The culprit has sand in their trainers.

habits.label: Sunburnt shoulders
clues: The back of the chair in the editing tent has white flakes of peeling skin, like from sunburnt shoulders. The culprit has sunburnt shoulders.
A towel smeared with after-sun cream was left at the pier. On the island that's what people rub on burnt shoulders. The culprit has sunburnt shoulders.

habits.label: Orange bandana
habits.habit: Wears an orange bandana with the show's logo
clues: An orange thread hangs on a nail by the generator shed door. Everyone was handed bandanas like that on the first day of filming. The culprit wears the show's orange bandana.
An orange scrap with the edge of the logo, torn from a bandana, lies on the confession booth floor. The culprit wears the show's orange bandana.

habits.label: Clip-on mic
habits.habit: Never takes the clip-on mic off their collar
clues: The audio track from the contestants' camp at 02:04 picks up fast breathing and rustling fabric, though no camera was filming there then. The culprit never takes off their clip-on mic.
A clip from a lapel mic, ripped off with a piece of fabric, lies in the sand by the back flap of the editing tent. The culprit never takes off their clip-on mic.

habits.label: Smells of repellent
clues: The editing tent is air-conditioned and has no mosquitoes, yet it reeks of mosquito spray. The culprit smells of repellent.
The pier railings have a greasy film with the same sharp smell as the mosquito spray cans. The culprit smells of repellent.

habits.label: Shell on a cord
habits.habit: A shell on a leather cord around the neck
clues: A little shell with a drilled hole lies under the table in the editing tent. They don't occur on the island; they're sold on the mainland. The culprit wears a shell on a cord.
A burnt leather cord with a knot, the kind shells are worn on, was found in the ashes of the beach campfire. The culprit wears a shell on a cord.

habits.label: White nose
habits.habit: Nose thickly covered in white zinc cream
clues: The monitor in the editing tent has a white smear of zinc cream, as if someone leaned right up to the screen. The culprit has a white-creamed nose.
The rubber seal of the generator shed door has a white sunscreen mark at face height. The culprit has a white-creamed nose.

habits.label: Roll-ups
clues: Two thin roll-up ends lie behind the editing tent, and only filter cigarettes were brought to the island. The culprit smokes roll-ups.
Rolling paper and a pinch of spilled tobacco are stuck between the planks of the pier. The culprit smokes roll-ups.

habits.label: Sunflower seeds
habits.habit: Cracks salted sunflower seeds by the handful
clues: There's a heap of seed husks at the entrance to the confession booth, though the cleaner went through at midnight. The culprit cracks sunflower seeds.
Salted seed husks are stuck to the wet seat of the dinghy at the pier. The culprit cracks sunflower seeds.

habits.label: Anchor on the hand
habits.habit: A small anchor tattooed on the back of the hand
clues: A second before it froze, the camera over the pier caught a hand on the rail with a small dark anchor on it. The culprit has an anchor tattoo on their hand.
There's a palm print on the dusty casing in the generator shed, and next to it a scrap of healing film with an anchor outline. The culprit has an anchor tattoo on their hand.

habits.label: Bandaged ankle
habits.habit: Ankle wrapped in an elastic bandage
clues: On the path from the contestants' camp to the editing tent every left footprint is smudged: someone was favouring a leg. The culprit has a bandaged ankle.
A new metal clip from an elastic bandage lies in the bin at the crew villa. The culprit has a bandaged ankle.

habits.label: Radio on the belt
habits.habit: Always has a walkie-talkie on their belt
clues: At 02:06 someone pressed a walkie-talkie button and said nothing, and the recording picks up the hum of the editing tent's air conditioner. The culprit carries a radio on their belt.
There's a dent in the sand by the generator shed from a dropped walkie-talkie and a mark from its aerial. The culprit carries a radio on their belt.

habits.label: Beeping watch
clues: At exactly two o'clock the confession booth recording picks up a short watch beep, though nobody's in the shot. The culprit's smartwatch beeps every hour.
The guard on the pier heard a double beep in the dark, like a watch on the hour, but saw nobody. The culprit's smartwatch beeps every hour.

habits.label: Eyebrow ring
habits.habit: A small silver ring in the eyebrow
clues: A tiny screw-on ball from a piercing lies on the editing tent floor. The culprit has an eyebrow ring.
In the confession booth recording, metal glints in the glass just above someone's eye. The culprit has an eyebrow ring.

habits.label: Mint gum
clues: A wad of gum, still soft and smelling of mint, is stuck under the table in the editing tent. The culprit chews mint gum.
A mint gum wrapper lies on the pier. Gum wasn't allowed on the island; someone smuggled it in their things. The culprit chews mint gum.

habits.label: Flip-flops
clues: There are ribbed heelless prints by the editing tent, the kind rubber flip-flops leave. The culprit wears flip-flops.
A flip-flop strap, torn out along with the toe post, lies by the campfire on the beach. The culprit wears flip-flops.

strong: Yartsev was sat back in his chair as if he'd fallen asleep at work, and the producer weighed close to a hundred kilos. The culprit is physically strong.
A full thirty-kilo jerrycan from the generator shed was carried across the sand to the pier and back. The culprit is physically strong.
tech: All twelve cameras froze in the same minute: someone changed the channel on the router in the generator shed without touching a single wire. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
Exactly the last forty minutes of footage were wiped from the drive in the editing tent; everything else is intact. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
quiet: The guard sat at the entrance to the editing tent and saw nobody. The back flap rustles at the slightest touch, but nobody heard that either. The culprit moves silently.
The pier planks creak with every step, yet the sound engineer recording the surf there didn't catch a sound. The culprit moves silently.
sched: Every night at two Yartsev edited the day's episode alone, and only insiders knew. The culprit knows the schedule.
The guard on the pier changes at 01:55, and for five minutes there's nobody there. The culprit knows the schedule.
french: A subtitle file is open on the monitor in the editing tent, and its last line is in French: "Fin de l'émission", meaning "End of broadcast". The culprit knows French.
On the back of a question sheet in the confession booth someone wrote "Il savait trop", French for "He knew too much". The culprit knows French.
medic: The thermos Yartsev drank tea from while editing has traces of a sleeping drug, dissolved so it couldn't be tasted. The culprit knows about poisons.
Two ampoules are missing from the first-aid kit at the crew villa, and the box was closed so neatly you'd think they were never there. The culprit knows about poisons.
driver: During the night someone took the dinghy to the next island and back: the motor is warm and the tank half empty. The culprit can drive.
The quad bike from the villa car park now stands by the generator shed, and its tyre tracks are fresh. The culprit can drive.
keys: The box with the contestants' phones at the villa was opened with a key, and one phone is in the wrong slot. The culprit had keys.
The generator shed is padlocked at night, yet tonight it was opened and locked again. The culprit had keys.
safe: The safe with the contestants' contracts at the villa was opened without a scratch, and three pages are missing. The culprit knows the safe combination.
The combination box with the day's footage on memory sticks was opened on the first try, and one stick is gone. The culprit knows the safe combination.
passages: A cable trench runs under the boards from the generator shed to the editing tent. Only the technicians know about it, and the boards over it have been moved. The culprit knows the service passages.
Behind the confession booth there's a small door for the camera operator who films from behind, and there's fresh sand on its hinges. The culprit knows the service passages.
tools: The back wall of the editing tent wasn't cut but unpicked along the seam and pulled back together with cable ties. The culprit is handy with tools.
The toolbox in the generator shed was opened with a screwdriver, and the 13 mm spanner was put back exactly in its place. The culprit is handy with tools.
cash: An amount equal to the weekly prize is missing from the envelope of daily allowances at the villa, and the ledger has been doctored. The culprit had access to money.
At 01:50 a transfer left the show's working account, and the confirmation code went to a phone locked in the crew box. The culprit had access to money.
